title: Silent mail loss: fallback smtp store errors not logged
description:
In crates/smtp/src/session.rs lines 928-932 and 937-942, the fallback delivery to the smtp-local store (called when the JMAP mail_pool lacks the user or the INBOX mailbox) silently discards the error with .ok() and no log. A maintainer debugging missing mail 6 months from now will see the warn for the primary path but nothing for the fallback failure — the message is gone with no trace.

Mitigation: replace .ok() with .unwrap_or_else(|e| warn!(peer=%peer_addr, %username, 'fallback smtp store deliver failed: {e}')) on both paths. This is a one-line fix per site.
